additional_info.subject: note from NOC to ES
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause :
Wrong serial number was added in SCC(
MP / S5 1700036201), which was later deleted by SC team, but couldn't re-board with correct serial no of MP / S5 170003620
Problem Description :
Charger not available in Sifinity Control
Action Performed (L2) :
created Jira ticket:
EVC3-9683
for deleting wrong serial no from SC & add correct serial no in SC.
Charger SW Version:
V6.0.3
Reason for Handover (L3) :
got reply form Sifinity team,
there is no process to onboard  Sicharge D on SC. You need to reach out to SCB team to ask them to delete this charger from SCB and re-onboard the charger to get it reflect on SC.
ES need to delete the charge from SCB & Re-onboard so that charger can reflect in Sifinity Control
Action Required
Action by HQ :
ES need to delete the charge from SCB & Re-onboard so that charger can reflect in Sifinity Control

additional_info.subject: Handover to NOC
additional_info.body:
As per discussion within ES Team, Product Champion will delete the charger from SCB.
As  per current process, NOC supports the re-onboarding of chargers on Sifinity. Please process the ticket as per normal process.
